# vvvv gamma - Package Library Reference

> Source: [vvvv/PublicContent Libraries.xml](https://github.com/vvvv/PublicContent/blob/master/Libraries.xml)
> This is the official curated list of vvvv packages, updated by the vvvv team.
> Full package catalog: https://vvvv.org/packs

## How to Add a Package

In a .vl document, add as a direct child of <Document> (NOT inside <Patch>):
```xml
<NugetDependency Id="{22-char-base62-id}" Location="VL.PackageName" Version="2025.7.*" />
```
Or use: **Edit > Manage NuGets** inside vvvv.

## Core / Built-in Packages

These ship with vvvv and are available without extra install:

| Package | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `VL.CoreLib` | Core nodes: Math, Collections, IO, Animation, Reactive, 2D/3D, Color, Control, Primitive, System |
| `VL.Stride` | 3D engine (Stride): SceneWindow, RootScene, Entity, Models, Materials, Cameras, Lights, Shaders |
| `VL.Skia` | 2D vector graphics (Skia engine) |
| `VL.Audio` | Audio playback, DSP, NAudio integration |
| `VL.IO.Redis` | Redis key-value store client |

## Total Packages in Catalog

230 unique packages (excluding Hidden category).
